messages.subject:
Re: [LAZY CONSENSUS] Limiting number of opened pull requests for
 users without write access
messages.body:
+1 to what Jarek and Vincent wrote. 5 as a cap sounds good.

Best,
Przemek

On 2026/09/21 19:23:05 Jarek Potiuk wrote:
> Correction: Thursday the 24th at 7:00pm CEST. - which is 72 hrs from the
> beginning of that thread,
> 
> And one more comment: I thought for a long time about the metrics "Threads
> vs. PRs". For me this is **embodiment** of community-aware, empathic
> contributor - on the way to become a commmiter. And I **knew** - because I
> checked it before - that practically **all** committers have a very high
> number here.
> 
> I deliberately never mentioned it in our discussions. As we all know,
> anything you set as a goal stops being a useful metric. There are always
> ways to game the system.
> 
> That's why I waited for quite a while to accumulate the data and showed
> completely different numbers - and never discussed the thread vs. PRs idea
> - to ensure this particular metric remained totally unbiased.
> And - just for the record - this is the last time this metric will be
> unbiased—now that we will publicly say we "care" about it.
> 
> And here is Claude's analysis on those top-20. And my thinking is that we
> should care about the needs of groups in this way: A > B > C.
> 
> ------------
> 
> Three buckets, all 24 (top-19 + the five-way tie at 6 open PRs)
> 
> Bucket rule, stated up front so the borderline calls are visible:
> engagement = others' threads per open PR (≥1.5 counts as engaged), quality
> = all-time merge rate (≥40% healthy). I picked these thresholds to match
> where the data actually clusters - there's a real gap between 1.7 and 0.8
> on engagement, and between 40% and 31% on the merge rate.
> 
> ---
> 
> A. Net reviewers — they give back more than they ask for (9 people, 103
> open PRs)
> 
> ┌─────────────────┬──────┬─────────────────┬─────────┬─────────┐
> │     Author      │ Open │ Threads/open PR │ Reviews │ Merge % │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ SameerMesiah97  │ 6    │ 60.3            │ 350     │ 90%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ shivaam         │ 6    │ 13.0            │ 55      │ 67%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ Vamsi-klu       │ 10   │ 10.8            │ 58      │ 38%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ Andrushika      │ 9    │ 4.6             │ 33      │ 79%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ yuseok89        │ 12   │ 3.8             │ 49      │ 77%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ steveahnahn     │ 14   │ 3.2             │ 40      │ 59%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ ColtenOuO       │ 23   │ 2.6             │ 70      │ 59%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ stephen-bracken │ 6    │ 2.3             │ 16      │ 56%     │
> ├─────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ fat-catTW       │ 17   │ 1.7             │ 33      │ 50%     │
> └─────────────────┴──────┴─────────────────┴─────────┴─────────┘
> 
> Vamsi-klu is the odd one: 108 threads and 58 reviews (bucket-A engagement)
> on a 38% merge rate. Placed here because the review effort is unambiguous.
> fat-catTW and stephen-bracken are the borderline entries - drop the
> threshold to 2.0 and fat-catTW moves out.
> 
> B. Shippers, not reviewers - volume with normal merge rates (6 people, 115
> open PRs)
> 
> ┌───────────────┬──────┬─────────────────┬─────────┬─────────┐
> │    Author     │ Open │ Threads/open PR │ Reviews │ Merge % │
> ├───────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ Eason09053360 │ 35   │ 0.3             │ 13      │ 52%     │
> ├───────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ 1fanwang      │ 34   │ 0.8             │ 36      │ 40%     │
> ├───────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ rjgoyln       │ 27   │ 0.7             │ 34      │ 53%     │
> ├───────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ Samin061      │ 7    │ 0.4             │ 4       │ 58%     │
> ├───────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ jeff3071      │ 6    │ 0.3             │ 7       │ 46%     │
> ├───────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ YAshhh29      │ 6    │ 0.2             │ 1       │ 45%     │
> └───────────────┴──────┴─────────────────┴─────────┴─────────┘
> 
> The work lands—merge rates here are ordinary, some above committer-adjacent
> levels—but the top three are carrying 96 open PRs between them while having
> commented on 56 of other people's threads in total. 1fanwang sits exactly
> on the 40% line.
> 
> C. Low engagement and low merge rate (9 people, 82 open PRs)
> 
> ┌───────────────────┬──────┬─────────────────┬─────────┬─────────┐
> │      Author       │ Open │ Threads/open PR │ Reviews │ Merge % │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ bujjibabukatta    │ 16   │ 0.2             │ 5       │ 11%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ anmolxlight       │ 12   │ 0.4             │ 12      │ 31%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ dheerenmohta      │ 10   │ 0.2             │ 0       │ 28%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ namanjain24-sudo  │ 8    │ 1.1             │ 1       │ 11%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ Kunal8954         │ 8    │ 0.8             │ 6       │ 20%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ bramhanandlingala │ 8    │ 0.0             │ 1       │ 22%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ zozo123           │ 7    │ 0.1             │ 6       │ 17%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ GayathriSrividya  │ 7    │ 0.0             │ 9       │ 22%     │
> ├───────────────────┼──────┼─────────────────┼─────────┼─────────┤
> │ nagasrisai        │ 6    │ 0.7             │ 6       │ 29%     │
> └───────────────────┴──────┴─────────────────┴─────────┴─────────┘
> 
> bramhanandlingala and GayathriSrividya have commented on zero threads they
> didn't author. This bucket is 82 open PRs with an aggregate merge rate
> around 21% - roughly four reviews spent per PR that eventually lands.
> 
> 
> 
> J.
> 
> 
> On Mon, Sep 21, 2026 at 9:09 PM Henry Chen <henrychen@apache.org> wrote:
> 
> > Thanks Jarek and Vincent for the detailed data and perspective that
> > context is really helpful. Seeing the actual numbers (especially that even
> > the top contributors rarely hit 5 open PRs), a cap of 5 makes sense to me
> > as a starting point. Happy to go with it and adjust later if we find it's
> > too tight in practice.
> >
> > Thanks
> > Henry
> >
> > ---------------------------------------------------------------------
> > To unsubscribe, e-mail: dev-unsubscribe@airflow.apache.org
> > For additional commands, e-mail: dev-help@airflow.apache.org
> >
> >
> 

---------------------------------------------------------------------

For additional commands, e-mail: dev-help@airflow.apache.org
